evidence.reason: The fixture's baseline commit runs without disabling or overriding inherited Git configuration. A developer/global `commit.gpgSign=true` can make `git commit` fail when no signing key is available, and an inherited `core.hooksPath` can run unrelated hooks during fixture commits/checkouts. That is a real test-hermeticity defect; setting local `commit.gpgSign=false` and an empty fixture hooks path before committing fixes it without changing intended behavior.
